name: clio.css
description: CSS library for Classic Mac OS and NeXTSTEP interfaces: Macintosh System 6, System 7, Mac OS 8.5 Drawing Board, Mac OS 8/9 Platinum and NeXTSTEP 3.3 windows, menus, buttons, scroll bars and dialogs, with every value traced to measured pixels.
author: clio.css contributors

scripts.test: node tooling/build.ts && node tooling/build-components.ts && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json && tsc -p tsconfig.components.preact.json && tsc -p tsconfig.components.react.json && tsc -p tsconfig.site.json
scripts.prepack: node tooling/build.ts && node tooling/build-components.ts && vitest run
scripts.build:font: python3 tooling/extract-glyphs.py --font chicago && python3 tooling/extract-glyphs.py --font geneva && python3 tooling/extract-glyphs.py --font geneva9 && python3 tooling/extract-glyphs.py --font charcoal && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-84 && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-text-84 && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-text-84-9 && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-97 && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-97-title && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-97 --exact && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-97-title --exact && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-97 --plain && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-97-title --plain && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-97 --plain --exact && python3 tooling/build-font.py clio-sans-97-title --plain --exact && python3 tooling/trace-outline.py
